exact_signal.fire_rule: fire on EVERY restricted event with sign(R) != 0; no magnitude threshold (mode 'sign'); 1 unit per fired event; no per-event netting (books.py build_ng3_a4_book mode 'sign' lines 154-156, 197-204; fired_events measured 72, dropped_tail_entries 0 — d2_feasibility_ng3.json totals_vs_declared.FXNG3-A4-P1.measured)
exact_signal.drift_definition: this is a drift/holding family, not an instant-reaction family: each fired event holds a fixed 1-unit signed USDCAD exposure for H = 5 consecutive grid days from the entry day ('exposure cells i..i+H-1'; the exit fill at i+H is NOT an exposure cell) (research/assets/forex_ng1/d2/events.py exposure_days lines 189-195; ng1 books.py cell convention lines 1-11; books.py DEFAULT_HOLD=5 line 77, build call hold=5 in research/control/forex_ng3_run/d2/d2_run.py lines 386-388)

construction.direction: sign(R) polarity: R < 0 -> LONG USDCAD (+1); R > 0 -> SHORT USDCAD (-1); exact-zero R -> no position. Measured book: 20 active cells, signs +1:10 / -1:10 (books.py build_ng3_a4_book line 200 'sign = 1 if r_pp < 0.0 else -1  # R<0 -> LONG USDCAD (+1)'; d2_feasibility_ng3.json structural_disclosures.books.FXNG3-A4-P1). construction.tie_breaking_law: Three explicit tie laws: (1) exact-zero R -> no position (books.py lines 197-199 'if r_pp == 0.0: no_position_sign_zero'); (2) overlapping same-pair cells from different events net to sign-of-sum; conflicting signs -> +1 if sum > 0 else -1, NEVER 0, net_collisions counted in meta (research/assets/forex_ng1/d2/books.py _add_cells lines 68-84; P-12 cell law); (3) Spearman average-tie ranks; constant vector -> None (rho.py _avg_tie_ranks lines 25-37, spearman lines 40-54). Structural tie hazard disclosed: the CA restricted stream's v2 availability days arrive in vintage-pull bursts (2018:8 / 2022:47 / 2024:17; none 2019-2021/2023/2025), so 72 events stack onto 20 distinct active grid days (d2_feasibility_ng3.json structural_disclosures; d2-measurement-handoff.json measurement_results.structural_disclosure).
construction.mandatory_battery_declared_but_unmeasure: The D1 proposal (bytes fde6228, sha256 6fe38d85..., on lane branch orca/fng3-d1-a4 — NOT in the reconstruction tree) carries the mandatory 5-arm battery: anchor + neighbour (4-event revision-momentum construction) + CTL-DGS10LEVEL nominal control (V8 law) + Q-7 clock shadow (adversarial constant long-USDCAD) + placebo on NON-REVISION vintage dates of the same pinned CA archive (research/control/FOREX-NG3/orchestration/handoffs/d1-a4-proposals-handoff.json summary; plans/PLAN_forex_ng3.md section 5 D1 wording 'mandatory nominal-exposure control (DGS10-level) + clock shadow + placebo (non-revision vintage dates) + neighbour'). At D2 only the anchor schedule, Q-6 feasibility, DGS10-level separability and the ancestry panel were measured (d2_run.py); neighbour/clock-shadow/placebo verdicts were never produced — the cycle died at D2 pre-score (terminal_report_ng3.json).
